story.iWant: to access the platform as a guest with limited functionality
story.soThat: I can explore public features before creating an account

tasks.task: Create landing page with feature overview (AC: #1, #2)
Integrate guest preferences with theme system (AC: #1)

criterion.given: I am not logged in and visit the platform
criterion.then: - Allows access to public pages (landing page, public statistics, feature overview) - Displays "Sign In" and "Sign Up" options prominently in navigation - Shows limited preview of analytics features (read-only, sample data or aggregated public data) - Prompts for account creation when trying to access personalized features - Stores guest preferences in session storage (theme, language) that persist for session duration
- Public overall statistics view (community-wide aggregated data) - Feature tour or demo mode - Marketing/landing page content - Documentation or help pages

criterion.when: I try to access features requiring authentication
criterion.then: - Clear "Sign In Required" message - Call-to-action to create account - Smooth transition to sign-up flow

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR6: Users can access the platform as guests with limited functionality. Guest access allows visitors to explore public features before creating an account.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: NextAuth.js 4.24.12 for session management. Role-based access control (RBAC) with roles: guest, user, moderator, admin. Middleware for route protection. Authorization levels: GUEST (public access), USER (authenticated users), ADMIN (administrative access).

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Request flow: User Request → Next.js App Router → HTTP Controller → Use Case → Domain Service → Repository/Adapter → Database. Middleware handles route protection and authentication checks.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Navigation system is visually appealing and intuitive with engaging visual feedback. Mobile: bottom navigation or hamburger menu. Desktop: sidebar or top tabs. Context-aware navigation organizes content logically.

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: Guest-accessible features include: Public overall statistics view (community-wide aggregated data), Feature tour or demo mode, Marketing/landing page content, Documentation or help pages. Features requiring authentication show clear "Sign In Required" message with call-to-action.

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: Middleware or route guards to distinguish authenticated vs guest routes. Guest session management (temporary, no database record). Public API endpoints for aggregated/public data. Reference: PRD FR6, UX Design Specification (Navigation patterns).

artifact.reason: Route protection proxy with cookie-based authentication. Defines protected routes, admin routes, and public routes. Handles authentication checks via auth-token cookie.
API authentication middleware for cookie-based authentication with Supabase. Throws AuthenticationError if authentication fails. Can be extended to support guest access detection.
Navigation service that returns menu items based on user role. Supports GUEST role. Can be extended to show guest-specific navigation items.
API endpoint for navigation menu. Already supports GUEST access - no authentication required. Returns menu items based on user role from cookie.
Component for protecting routes that require authentication. Can be extended to show "Sign In Required" message for guest users trying to access protected routes.
Component that renders content only for guest users. Useful for showing guest-specific UI elements like sign-up prompts.
Main navigation component. Should be updated to show "Sign In" and "Sign Up" options prominently for guests, and hide authenticated-only items.
NextAuth.js session helpers. Use existing authentication infrastructure for guest vs authenticated user detection.
Theme preference system. Extend to support guest preferences in session storage (not database, as guests have no user record).
Zustand auth store. Can be extended to track guest state and preferences. Use session storage for guest preferences (not Zustand persistence, as it's temporary).

ecosystem.name: node
ecosystem.package: Next.js framework with App Router, middleware support
Client state management (for guest preferences in session storage)
Server state management for API calls

constraint.description: Use Next.js middleware or route guards to distinguish authenticated vs guest routes. Follow Clean Architecture patterns with separation of concerns.
Guest session management is temporary with no database record. Store guest preferences in session storage (browser sessionStorage API) that persist for session duration only.
Public API endpoints for aggregated/public data should be in src/app/api/public/ directory. Use Zod validation for all API endpoints.
Use session storage for guest preferences (temporary), TanStack Query for server state, Zustand for client state. Do not use Zustand persistence for guest preferences (session-only).
Mobile-first approach with breakpoints at 320px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px. All components must be responsive and accessible.
WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance required, minimum 4.5:1 color contrast ratio for text. All interactive elements must be keyboard accessible.
Maintain minimum 80% test coverage. Write tests before implementation (TDD). Include unit tests, integration tests, E2E tests, and accessibility tests using @axe-core/playwright.
Use ShadCN/UI components from src/components/ui/. Follow existing component patterns. Public components in src/components/public/, auth components in src/components/auth/.

interface.name: Navigation Menu API
interface.description: Returns navigation menu items based on user role. Already supports GUEST role. No authentication required.

interface.name: Public Statistics API
interface.description: Returns aggregated public statistics (community-wide data). No authentication required. Should include caching for performance.

interface.name: Guest Session Service
interface.description: Service for managing guest session preferences (theme, language) in session storage. No database interaction.

interface.name: Route Protection Middleware
interface.description: Middleware to protect routes and redirect guests from protected routes to sign-in with return URL.

tests.standards: Testing follows TDD approach with Red-Green-Refactor cycle. Minimum 80% test coverage required. Test types: unit tests for components and utilities, integration tests for guest access flow, E2E tests for complete guest access flow, accessibility tests using @axe-core/playwright. All tests must verify WCAG 2.1 AA compliance. Guest access testing includes: complete flow (landing → public stats → protected route → sign-in redirect), guest preferences persistence, public API accessibility. Route protection testing includes: middleware correctly identifies public vs protected routes, redirects work correctly, authentication requirements enforced.

idea.description: Test guest can access public pages (landing, public stats, docs) without authentication
Test navigation displays "Sign In" and "Sign Up" options prominently for guests
Test guest preferences (theme, language) are stored in session storage and persist during session
Test guest preferences are cleared when session ends (browser close)
Test public statistics API returns aggregated community-wide data without authentication
Test feature tour/demo mode displays sample data correctly for guests
Test documentation/help pages are accessible without authentication
Test "Sign In Required" component displays when guest tries to access protected route
Test redirect to sign-up flow with return URL stored for post-authentication redirect
Test middleware correctly identifies and protects authenticated-only routes
Test smooth transition to sign-up flow from protected route access attempt
E2E test: Guest visits landing page → Views public stats → Tries to access dashboard → Redirected to sign-in → Signs up → Redirected back to dashboard
Accessibility test: Verify all guest-accessible pages meet WCAG 2.1 AA compliance using @axe-core/playwright
